Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:34116

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 4974 of 2025
Applicant :- Sudhir Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin.Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Madhulika Yadav,Devendra Kumar Singh,Manisha Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Madhulika Yadav, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Arvind Kumar Pandey, the
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
361/2025, under Sections 69, 351(3), 115(2), 333 of B.N.S., Police Station Sushant Golf City, District Lucknow South (Commissionerate Lucknow).
3.

The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 30.04.2025 against the applicant and his fiance Sweety Verma stating that the informant got married to Wasim Ahmed on 06.11.2024.
Prior to marriage, she was in a relation with the applicant.
After her marriage the applicant started blackmailing her and threatened to kill her husband.
The applicant and co-accused Sweety Verma forcibly entered her house and in presence of Sweety Verma the applicant repetitively raped her and took away Rs. 70,000/-.

sentences.text:
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
5.
Several photographs and whatsApp communication between the parties have been annexed with the bail application to indicate that the informant was in an affectionate relationship with the applicant.

6. A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant stating that the applicant is involved in Case Crime No. 432/2021, under Sections 406, 504, 376 & 313 IPC, Police Station Banthara, District Lucknow in which the applicant has been granted anticipatory bail by means of an order dated 27.07.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.
1665/2023.
7.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application and he has produced the relevant extract of the case diary for perusal of the Court which discloses that the victim has reiterated the FIR version in her statements under Sections 180 & 183 Cr.P.C.
However, the victim has declined to undergo medico legal examination.
The investigation is still pending.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the allegation that the applicant raped the informant in presence of his lady friend appears to be highly unnatural; that the informant has declined to undergo medico legal examination, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
